title: YOUR MAMA DON'T DANCE
lyrics_plain:
Your mama don't dance
and your daddy don't rock and roll
No your mama don't dance
and your daddy don't rock and roll
But when evening rolls around
and it's time to go to town
Where do you go   to rock and roll
The old folks say
that you gotta end your day by ten
But if you're out on a date
don't you bring her home late   it's a sin
You know there's no excuse
and you know you're gonna lose
You never win   I'll say it again
And it's all because your mama don't dance
and your daddy don't rock and roll
No your mama don't dance
and your daddy don't rock and roll
But when evening rolls around
and it's time to hit the town
Where do you go?   to rock and roll
